query:
insert into RootRequirements (
                product_id,
                req_id
            )
            select r.product_id, r.id
            from Requirements r
            where not exists (
                select *
                from RequirementHierarchies rh
                where rh.child_product_id = r.product_id
                and rh.child_req_id = r.id
            )
